config.scope: Intel CPU mixed matrix precision test. No weights trained; all audio/nonlinear interfaces FP32. Approximate variants are evaluated for quality, not claimed bitwise or FP32 parity.

models.name: int8_all
models.precision_description: Matrix operands only; FP32 accumulation/output for FP16, INT32 accumulation then FP32 output for INT8. Snake, depthwise, bias/residual and final waveform convolution retain FP32.
